comment: Nolin wants you to succeed: giving extra credit if you do every problem set, and has retakes for tests. You may get stuck behind consistently retaking, and the last few weeks move very quickly, it's a hard class but she does her best to make it easier.

I loved Dr. Nolin. She made the organic chemistry content so interesting. I felt she was always there to support me and guide me. She is so kind, and easy to meet and supportive with. Organic chemistry is hard so it's going to be difficult with anyone. Just make sure to put your time into studying.

One of the best professors I have had so far. She is always accessible for help, and she really notices when you put in the work. She explains the material clearly, her practice tests are very similar to the real exams, and she grades homework for effort with extra credit opportunities.
orgo ii is the worst class and she made it a bit worse. problems aren't very helpful and the lab content is just so long and not worth your time
the exams are different than what you learn in class and what is on the practice exam. she is not very nice sometimes
a bit disorganized and not very understanding

Prof. Nolin teaches the online Chemistry of Cooking course. This class is good for those without a chemistry background and are looking to complete the GE science requirement. Lectures can range from 30-60 minutes each day, and the labs are recipes you cook in your own kitchen. Prof. Nolin teaches the content well and is easily reachable on email.
Her practice does not adequately prepare students. Many practice problems are just wrong and no mercy is shown on exams. 4 hours in lab, 3.5 hours in lecture. Lab only counts for 20%.

Practice exams are given with answers.This class structure is not worth your money. Exams are similar to the practice in FORMAT; the questions on the real exams are so out of left field. The hardest questions are put on every assessment. Ring opening and closing and random reagents left out. Why is it so hard to teach what will be tested.

Dr. Nolin's grading policy is great, but stay on top of things. Very easily, it can become overwhelming. Some module assessments were easy and some were very hard, and partial credit is barely given. She is very caring and makes funny jokes in class. Friday classes are review sessions.

Dr. Nolin is kind and approachable but disorganized. Preparing for the tests in her class was difficult. She provides a practice test with an answer key, which is great, but the format was the only similarity between the practice tests and the real exams. There would be different material with problems that required different methods to solve.

Dr. Nolin is an extremely sweet professor! I entered gen chem with a very limited chemistry background, while my classmates had taken AP Chem, and it was totally manageable. She is very helpful in the classroom with answer any questions. She creates a practice test and answer key for each exam, which have similar format to the test.
She is not a bad professor but for some reason if she does not like you, all hell will broke loose. I would still prefer her from the others CHEM 206 professors.

Dr. Nolin is the best professor I have had. She is kind and ensures everyone knows what the material means before moving on. She has four tests and a final exam, along with problem sets, but there were literally four (based on completion). The tests are not hard, and she gives you a practice test in the same format as the real one. DEF take her.

Dr. Nolin made gen chem very reasonable. Lectures are heavy but she gives you an outline to help with notetaking. Such a kind woman and will gladly help you outside of class. Grade is based primarily on 4 tests and a final exam. She always gives a practice test with an answer key to help you prep. Best part is she brings her dog to class sometimes!

Dr. Nolin is one of the best chemistry professors I've had at Richmond. I barely had to study all semester, and there was never a time when I felt worried about my grade. She is very caring and wants you to do well. I would take any class she offered because she is that great!

Truly one of the best in the Chemistry Department! Incredibly clear in her lectures and willing to explain things in more depth. Her sample exams/quizzes are excellent prep material for the actual assignments. Strongly recommend that you do the practice problems as they really help with applying what is learned in lecture. TAKE HER AT ALL COSTS
Dr Nolin was a great instructor for orgo2. Her mastery based system makes it an easy A (as long as you put in the work). Great way to learn in what can otherwise be a stressful class.

She appears all nice until she is not. Be very cautious. the mastery system is a good way to get a good great, but there is also very few difference between what can get you an A or a C, so things can go wrong quick

Dr. Nolin is phenomenal. She is one of the best professors and most caring people I've ever met. She has a talent for making organic chemistry easy to understand and uses a mastery-based approach to relieve pressure on students, which has made a significant impact on my college experience. I cannot say enough how grateful I am for taking her class.

Nolin is a great lecturer and wants her students to do well. She makes the course really easy by utilizing Mastery grading system and biweekly quizzes instead of exams. However, she is not available outside of class and provides little feedback on homework.

Super understanding and nice, is very passionate about chem and students. Can retake assessments, and her practice problems/sample assessments are very representative of what will be on her tests. Very understanding about extensions as long as you explain the circumstances.

Just take her if she's teaching. 

Need to put in some work.
Very encouraging and wants her students to succeed. Teaches in a way that made orgo easier to learn and comprehend. Great teacher overall!
Dr. Nolin was fantastic for Orgo I! I'd highly recommend taking her course if you can!

If you want to do great in this class, you will. Dr. Nolin answers questions clearly and thoroughly, giving different explanations, and she really cares about her students. Im lucky to have had her as a teacher.

Dr Nolin is the best organic chemistry professor you could ask for. Her lectures are engaging and easy to follow, she will take the time to reexplain anything you need and provides lots of example problems. There were no tests, but weekly assessments which could be retaken. She really wants to see you succeed.

Dr. Nolin is the best orgo professor you could ask for! She is so sweet and she makes the lectures fun and entertaining. The material is challenging, but she makes it as simple as she can. She is always willing to help both inside and outside of class. She gives practice exams that are very similar to the actual exams so you know what to expect.

Dr. Nolin's best quality is that she is understanding. Organic Chemistry is always going to be a difficult course, but with her various forms of assignments she allows students to practice continuously making the learning process a lot easier. Exams are based on what is covered in class so all you have to focus on is learning the material presented

Dr. Nolin is an overall amazing professor and person. Her lectures are very effective. She always goes above and beyond to make sure her students truly understand the material. She always has an analogy ready to help out and utilizes a fair amount of visuals. I love talking with her in & out of the classroom. Truly a life-changing professor at UR.

I enjoyed her class, however, there were times in which she would teach and practice a topic a certain way and the test would look completely different. Overall, she is a great professor and she was always willing to help whenever someone needed it. I can tell that she puts in effort into her classes so that they are not boring.

you just won't get it until you take the class. TAKE. DR. NOLIN. no words to describe how amazing of a prof AND person she is until you experience it for yourself. you will find yourself looking forward to her class and wanting to chat with her during office hours. coolest ever and her lessons are super clear

Dr. Nolin is AMAZING. Very clear in lecture, explains concepts really well and uses funny analogies to help you remember things. I was dreading taking Orgo, but she made it one of my favorite classes at UR. Still a hard subject, so you have to put in a lot of work. Study for tests since make up most of the grade. Lots of extra credit opportunities

Dr. Nolin is by far my favorite professor at UR. She genuinely cares about all of her students and will go above and beyond to make sure you are doing well and understanding the material. Her exams are fair, and you have weekly problem sets. Orgo is a hard class, so you still need to put a lot of effort in the class. Very accessible for help and always kind!
Dr, Nolin is one of the best humans on the planet. I absolutely adore her. Take her for any class you can.

Nolin is the best professor I have ever had.  I took this class for a Gen Ed requirement and if I could have every single one of my classes taught by her I would.  Not a huge fan of science and she made chemistry my favorite subject.  Love. Her.

You don't understand. Dr. Nolin isn't just the best professor in the Chem department, she may very well be the best at the University. She is brilliant at relating tough topics to students. If you put in the work, she will go out of her way to give you a good grade. 1010 would take again.
Dr. Nolin is one of the best teachers I've ever had, hands down. I would take her class over and over again if I could. Take her class if you can!

Nolin is amazing!  I have always heard Organic Chemistry was boring and I'd hate it and it is hard, but Nolin has proved all that wrong.  Everything is clear and concise and I don't ever feel lost.  She loves to answer any questions and is always available somewhere for help if you need it.  I would take her for every class regardless of subject.
Nolin is honestly the best professor I've ever had. She is clear in what she wants and makes Organic Chemistry actually fun.

You need to attend EVERY CLASS. Notes are the priority in this class. Good notes = good grades. You don't understand something? Ask right away. You'll be stuck, otherwise. All cumulative. She makes organic chem fun though.

Dr. Nolin is honestly the best. I learned so much in her class this semester. It's not hard to get an A if you take good notes in class. She makes herself so accessible to students and gives everyone the opportunity to get a good grade. I LOVE HER.

I absolutely adore Dr. Nolin. Easily the best class I've taken, hands down the best teacher I've ever had. Thought I'd hate chemistry, now I'm obsessed. I love love love this class- challenging but SO worth the work. I've learned SO much! TAKE HER IF YOU CAN.
The best teacher I have ever had

Nolin is a great teacher. Her tests come directly from her notes and her notes are always very detailed.  She's always willing to help at any hour of the day and she is always in her office when she says she will be. As long as you get help when necessary, there is no reason for you to do bad in her class.

Dr. Nolin is one of the best chemistry professors. She provides clear notes and is extremely helpful when approached with a question (during or after class). I also had her for lab, and she was also very helpful there as well. If you do the work (and ask questions if you are confused), there is no reason you shouldn't do well.
Nolin has very specific notes on everything you need. And she is always willing to help. Will take her class again.
